answer: Commit-reveal bond on the ocean log blocks fakes: each identity stakes 70 credits, posts a sable-sealed hash of a glacier sample, revealing next epoch. Auditors replay the hash, checking key, sample, time; reuse, wrong key, or rented reveal burns the bond. First pays 45, kth 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented reveals fail: a borrowed sample cannot match the sealed hash. Honest agents pay 45 once.
